2  (BY SHRI RAHUL SOLANKI, GOVT. ADVOCATE.)

These applications coming on for admission this day, th  the following:
 ORDER Heard with the aid of case diary.
These applications are first application filed under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of bail to the applicants, in connection with FIR/Crime No.9/2024, Date:-(Not mentioned) registered at P.S.-Dwarkapuri, District- Indore (M.P.) for commission of offence punishable under Sections 420,
467 & 468 of the IPC.
2.

Prosecution story in brief is that, during 12.01.2021 to 14.02.2022 the main accused Mohammad Sharif introducing himself as owner of the land, executed agreement to sale of the land in favour of complainants Mangubai, Prakash Verma, Rewa Ram, Mira Solanki, Vishnu Bhatt and Kamlabai.
He also received Rs.13,31,000-/ from complainant party as earnest money while the main accused Mohammad Sharif was not the owner of the questioned land.
It is alleged that present applicants Jagdish Choudhary and Ganesh Chandanshiv put their signature on the agreement executed in favour of Prakash Verma and Mira Solanki.
3. Learned counsel for the applicants submits that applicants have not committed the offence and they have falsely been implicated in the case.
It is submitted that name of the applicants are not mentioned in the FIR.
It is also submitted that they have not executed any agreement and have also not received money from the complainant party.
It is further submitted that as alleged main accused Mohammad Sharif who executed agreement to sale in favour of the complainant.
Applicant are in custody since 15.02.2024.
Applicants have no criminal antecedents.
After completion of investigation charge sheet has been filed.
Conclusion of the trial will take sufficient long time for its disposal.
Under these circumstances, prayer is made for grant of bail to the applicants.
4. On the other hand, learned counsel for the non-applicant/State as well as counsel for the Objector have opposed the prayer of the applicants and prays for is rejection.

5. Having considered the submissions advanced from counsel for the parties, also considering the facts and circumstances, without commenting on the merits of the case, this Court is of the view that applicants deserves to be enlarged on bail.
Hence, bail applications are allowed.

6. It is directed that the applicants- JAGDISH CHOUDHARY & GANESH CHANDANSHIV be released on bail upon their furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only)each with separate sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of the concerned trial Court for their appearance before the trial Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this behalf Jagdish Choudhary vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/25143871/
2 by the trial Court during pendency of the trial.
